races.paceDynamic: We Ride At Dawn provides the only confirmed front-running threat in this 14-runner handicap, likely to dictate terms from the rail without serious early pressure. Roserunner and Kingofthecarnival may sit prominent but both have shown willingness to settle, while the majority are hold-up performers including Karakula Dancer, Suggy, and Aneirin's Sword. The uncontested early pace will create a tactical race where positioning becomes crucial, with the long Kempton straight rewarding those who can time their runs perfectly. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and forward hold-up horses who can avoid trouble and travel into contention, rather than pure front-runners or deep closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Front End Advantage
scenarios.trigger: If We Ride At Dawn sets steady fractions and Roserunner/Kingofthecarnival track him closely without pressure.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows the front division to control the race and kick clear when it matters. Those racing handy avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will plague the large pack of hold-up horses in behind.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Stampede
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely steady and the field bunches up turning for home.
scenarios.body: A cavalry charge develops in the straight with multiple hold-up horses fanning wide and timing their runs. Class and finishing kick separate them rather than early positioning, favouring the most consistent performers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If We Ride At Dawn sets stronger fractions than expected and begins to weaken approaching the final furlong.
scenarios.body: The pace-setter's effort creates perfect conditions for those tracking in second and third to inherit the lead smoothly. They benefit from a strong gallop without having done the donkey work themselves.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If We Ride At Dawn goes too slow and the race becomes a sprint finish with 20+ horses still in contention.
scenarios.body: The race turns into a messy scramble where draw, luck in running, and raw speed matter more than tactical positioning. Horses with natural pace have a significant edge over pure stayers.

watchPoints.text: We Ride At Dawn's fitness after 210 days off will determine if he can sustain his front-running role or become a sitting duck
Karakula Dancer drawn widest in stall 14 faces serious tactical disadvantage getting position in this large field
Market support for debutants Fizzy Bear and Little Chief would signal stable confidence on new surfaces
Multiple hold-up horses including Suggy, Hakin Adraar returning from long breaks may need the run
Oisin Murphy's booking of unfancied Ziggy's Avenger suggests stable expects improvement from gelding operation

races.paceDynamic: Sant Alessio is the lone confirmed front runner and will get an easy lead without pressure from the gate. With most runners preferring to settle (9 hold-up types, 4 prominent), this creates a tactical race where the pace will be moderate early before quickening late. The lack of early pace pressure means Sant Alessio can dictate fractions and kick when ready, while the hold-up brigade including Dannick, Lady Manzor, and Cephalus will rely on finding gaps in the straight. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to Sant Alessio without having to come from too far back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Easy Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Sant Alessio gets uncontested fractions and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The 197-day absence becomes irrelevant as he controls the race throughout and quickens off sustainable splits. His two wins last year both came from prominent positions in similar tactical affairs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling and the field bunches up for a sprint finish

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes

scenarios.label: D

scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy scramble where draw and luck in running matter more than ability. Any horse getting a clear run can win.

races.paceDynamic: Bell Shot and Lexington Jet are confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead, creating an honest gallop from the start. With 14 runners and two pace-setters willing to go forward, this sets up a searching test that should expose any fitness doubts. The sustained tempo will stretch the field out and create opportunities for prominent racers like Rock Iguana, Noodle Mission and Sea Suite to track the pace without getting too far back. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and forward movers who can sit close enough to strike, as the dual pace angle should soften up the leaders for those tracking just behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Bell Shot and Lexington Jet duel early and weaken
scenarios.body: The honest pace will set up perfectly for Rock Iguana, Noodle Mission or Sea Suite to sweep past the tiring leaders. Those sitting prominently will have the tactical advantage as the front runners pay for their early battle.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold Up Specialists
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate despite two leaders
scenarios.body: Farasi Lane, I'm Workin On It, or Tiger Crusade can time their runs from the back as the tempo allows them to close strongly. The quality hold-up horses will have enough left in the tank for a finishing kick.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of Bell Shot or Lexington Jet gets an easy lead
scenarios.body: The survivor of the early pace battle could kick clear and hold on, especially if the other front runner doesn't engage seriously. Bell Shot has the class edge if he can dictate terms alone.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint
scenarios.body: Brunel Nation or Al Karrar could sneak through if the race becomes a mad dash, though both need significant pace help. The lightweights at big odds could outfinish tired favourites in a slowly-run affair.

races.paceDynamic: Many A Star is the lone confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the gate, likely getting an uncontested lead through moderate fractions. The prominent runners Change Sings, Moving Force, and Hockney lack the natural speed to apply early pressure, allowing Many A Star to control the tempo. With 9 of 12 runners showing hold-up tendencies, this creates a compressed field tracking the leader before a cavalry charge in the final two furlongs. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce their best turn of foot from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Many A Star sets steady fractions and the hold-up brigade get racing room
scenarios.body: The veteran leader weakens in the final furlong as fresher closers sweep past with superior finishing kicks. Multiple hold-up specialists benefit from the tactical setup and strong gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Many A Star maintains his recent AW form and gets soft enough fractions
scenarios.body: The 9-year-old proves too tough from the front, holding off late challenges with his proven stamina reserves. His February Wolverhampton win suggests he retains ability when conditions suit.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pace Tactics
scenarios.trigger: If Change Sings or Moving Force show more early speed than expected
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more testing with multiple horses vying for position, setting up a true staying test. This favours horses with both tactical speed and stamina reserves over pure closers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos In Running
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates traffic problems or interference in the home straight
scenarios.body: Several hold-up horses get blocked runs while others find clear passages to exploit. The race becomes more about luck than ability, throwing up a surprise winner.

races.paceDynamic: Uzincso is the sole confirmed front-runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead with The Bay Warrior and Master Dancer potentially tracking from prominent positions early. The majority of this field are hold-up performers (Divot, Marinakis, Pablo Prince, Maywedance, Voix De Bocelli, Sir Patchy, Dotties Star, Big Take, Argentum) who will need the pace to develop. With minimal early pressure on Uzincso, he can dictate fractions over the 1m4f trip at Kempton's turning track. This race shape strongly favours the front-runner and prominent racers, as the large contingent of hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground if the pace becomes pedestrian.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If Uzincso gets an easy lead with minimal early pressure from the field.
scenarios.body: He can control the tempo and kick clear in the straight while the hold-up brigade struggle to close the gap on the turning Kempton track. His course record (seven wins here) and recent 1m3f success make him perfectly suited to exploit this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Uzincso goes too slow early and gets swamped by the field turning for home.
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their preferred scenario with a sprint finish, allowing the strongest finishers to showcase their turn of foot. Divot and Pablo Prince have shown recent form over this trip and can capitalize.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Success
scenarios.trigger: If The Bay Warrior or Master Dancer press Uzincso early and create genuine pace.
scenarios.body: This creates an honest gallop that suits horses with tactical speed who can track the leaders without being too far back. The Bay Warrior's recent frame finishes at this distance put him in the ideal position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong throughout and the early leaders collapse completely.
scenarios.body: The most patient hold-up performers get the perfect setup with a strong gallop to aim at in the final furlong. Marinakis has winning form on Polytrack and could benefit most from this scenario.
